notes.title: Playtest available!
notes.content:
Welcome Commanders,

Please join the fight, your aid is now needed.
Playtest are open & available.

Stay brave commanders.

notes.title: Free Demo Coming During July!
notes.content:
Big news! Free demo available very soon! ːsteamhappyː

Main menu completed & now working on some details regarding multiplayer and optimization!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941555/b07edfb94c258065740ffb2da0232783daf9684c.jpg

Optimisation & Steam integration needs more work in order to be fully operational, but the free Demo will be available during July!

===> Add to Wishlist & Follow!
====>And get news, updates, free demo & huge discount at launch!

This small action really helps us and you will get updates about the game release!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941555/f3970aa12831f8120a099837330625c35e257809.gif

Check the discord chanel if you have any question or if you want to stay tuned!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941555/760b94fc86ffa7fcc27b24462fda462b7e4a1244.png
